scope: Product lifecycle and fit opportunities from DeerFlow and Agent Canvas; representative source paths plus current primary documentation and selected issues. Not an every-line or security audit.

pinned_sources.external_runtime_boundary: Agent Server/SDK and Automation Server are separately versioned; current full runtime not tested.

critical_distinctions: DeerFlow scheduler and durable batches default disabled.
DeerFlow project documents do not imply project-isolated memory.
Canvas source UI and advertised cloud/enterprise are not one capability set.
Canvas hosted critic is experimental, optional and not universal to ACP agents.
Agent Workspaces single-file export and saved workflows already exist; full restore and recurrence do not.
Artifact integrity and successful tool receipts are not semantic task correctness.
Issue sample and feature presence do not prove market fit.

own_source_evidence.finding: Current workflow input types and owner commands contain no scheduling or portability contract.
Saved workflows reuse objective, criteria and policy with generic editable fields.
Narrow browser/code/Gmail/collaboration tools and explicit output authority.
Current result preview is bounded plain text or metadata, and file export exists.
Current verified-result wording and usage counters.
Outstanding Phase 7 packaging, restore, sleep/wake and integrated release gates.

recommendations.proposal_and_current_gap: **Guided first useful result.** Job-specific readiness checklist for model, required account, browser and container; preserve the draft; one clearly labeled synthetic sample; install/reconnect actions plus diagnostic export. Current starter forms and scattered settings remain foundations.
recommendations.value_differentiation_effort: All audiences; high activation value, moderate differentiation; M plus existing Phase 7 release work.
recommendations.dependencies_and_boundaries: Mac package/restore proof; credential setup UI; checks report not-tested separately from failed. Paid connection probe only explicit.
recommendations.validation_experiment: Observe 12 fresh users, 4 business/agency, 4 developer, 4 personal. Candidate gate: at least 9 reach a correctly scoped real deliverable without developer intervention; median <=10 minutes after required external account consent. Record every failure, not only completers.

recommendations.proposal_and_current_gap: **Result review desk.** Render safe Markdown, bounded tables and citations; show each criterion as checked / needs review / unmet with evidence; compare output versions and export a shareable result pack. Current immutable files and plain-text preview are reused.
recommendations.value_differentiation_effort: All; high value and strong trust differentiation; M.
recommendations.dependencies_and_boundaries: Safe renderers, output MIME limits, evidence-to-criterion contract, human acceptance separate from automatic artifact integrity. No active HTML on app origin.
recommendations.validation_experiment: Blind-review 20 outputs against source fixtures. Target zero unsupported checked labels; reviewers find planted omissions and approve/reject in under 2 minutes median. Then test real reports for usefulness.

recommendations.proposal_and_current_gap: **Client/project knowledge collections.** Explicitly selected briefs, brand rules and reference documents plus saved workflows, with source/expiry/version shown. Add "use these versions" rather than implicit cross-client memory.
recommendations.value_differentiation_effort: Agencies/business high; developer/personal useful; strong privacy differentiation; M-L.
recommendations.dependencies_and_boundaries: Durable project membership, scoped search, deletion/restore, per-task version grants. Do not move private agent files into shared visibility automatically.
recommendations.validation_experiment: Three-client fixture with conflicting instructions; zero cross-client retrieval. Five agency users run second jobs; compare setup time and corrections against current workflow cloning.

recommendations.proposal_and_current_gap: **Scheduled briefs with change-only notifications.** Turn an existing saved workflow into a daily/weekly bounded read-only run. Show next run/timezone, run history, missed-run policy, maximum spend and expiration.
recommendations.value_differentiation_effort: Business/personal high, developer medium; moderate differentiation, L.
recommendations.dependencies_and_boundaries: Complete sleep/wake gates; durable leases/idempotency; shared daily cap; non-overlap; explicit stop; Mac awake/app running statement. Missing inputs create Needs-you item, never guessed answers.
recommendations.validation_experiment: Fourteen-day pilot across 8 users. Measure useful runs, duplicate/missed occurrences, intervention time, weekly return and spend per accepted result. Ship gate: zero duplicate dispatch in restart/sleep/DST fixture suite.

recommendations.proposal_and_current_gap: **Scoped connections for specific jobs.** After current Gmail, add selected Drive documents/Sheets or GitHub read-only review, based on observed target jobs. A connection card shows account, permitted resource and health.
recommendations.value_differentiation_effort: Business/agency/developer; high integration value, moderate differentiation; L per provider.
recommendations.dependencies_and_boundaries: OAuth app/scopes/verification, pagination, expiry, rate limits, consent and deletion; connector tool dispatcher enforces scope. MCP alone is not a permission model.
recommendations.validation_experiment: Concierge 10 real recurring jobs first. Build only the connector removing the most manual file/browser steps; compare task completion and reconnect burden. No forecasted usage from GitHub stars.

recommendations.proposal_and_current_gap: **Workflow contracts beyond saved prompts.** Named typed input slots, output format, stable deterministic preprocessing/validation steps, sample inputs and versioned definition. Current saved workflow copies brief, criterion and policy but not a reusable input schema.
recommendations.value_differentiation_effort: All; business/agency high reuse; moderate differentiation; M-L.
recommendations.dependencies_and_boundaries: Existing request validators/artifact broker; signed or owner-reviewed imports later; no arbitrary plugin installation. LLM reserved for judgment, not CSV counting.
recommendations.validation_experiment: Run one weekly spreadsheet report over 10 variant fixture inputs. All invalid inputs explain missing fields before paid generation; valid schema remains consistent across reruns. Measure repeat-user editing time.

recommendations.proposal_and_current_gap: **Run receipts and useful recovery.** Timeline of last successful step, reason stopped, retry eligibility, files created and actual cost; compare attempts and export a redacted support bundle. Current activity and cost counts exist; upgrade explanation and cross-run analysis.
recommendations.value_differentiation_effort: All; high trust and support value; moderate differentiation; M.
recommendations.dependencies_and_boundaries: Redaction, stable event IDs, bounded pagination, schema version. Distinguish read retry from uncertain external write; never replay submission blindly.
recommendations.validation_experiment: Seed 8 faults: expired auth, missing file, Docker stopped, no network, budget exhausted, browser owner control, crash, repeated invalid action. At least 7 recover without developer help; zero leaked secrets in export fixture scan.

recommendations.proposal_and_current_gap: **Visible team plan and scoped delegation.** Owner sees proposed independent assignments, input versions, expected outputs, shared budget and review responsibility; supervisor can launch only authorized tasks/agents. Existing peer messages and waits remain mechanisms.
recommendations.value_differentiation_effort: Agency/research/developer; strong product identity, L; postpone behind simpler successful jobs.
recommendations.dependencies_and_boundaries: Parent/child durable accounting, explicit publishing, cancellation propagation, dependency graph, per-agent cap; do not inherit another agent's browser or private context.
recommendations.validation_experiment: Compare single agent vs two specialists on 12 matching tasks. Continue only with measurable quality or elapsed-time benefit at acceptable cost, zero permission bleed and inspectable failures. No assumption that more agents perform better.

recommendations.proposal_and_current_gap: **Portable workflow packs and selected-task export.** Export reviewed workflow definition, selected references/outputs and provenance; import as disabled draft with fresh account/permission review. Existing single-file export is not workspace backup.
recommendations.dependencies_and_boundaries: Phase 7 portable backup/restore, manifests/hashes/version compatibility, no cookies/tokens/private history by default. Workflow transfer and full recovery backup must remain distinct.
recommendations.validation_experiment: Move three workflows and one selected-task pack to a clean test data root; rebind accounts, run fixtures, prove no hidden credentials/grants carried over. Ask pilot users whether this supports real handover.

limitations: No accounts or runtime setup performed.
No paid or live model quality evaluation.
Official docs may be newer than pinned checkout.
Issue states are rendered-page observations and were not reproduced.
Effort ratings and experiment thresholds are proposed product judgments.

challenge_review.report_section: Current product dependencies found in challenge review
material_dependencies: Shared means all agents; client grouping requires a new access boundary.
Read-only browser and Gmail policies cannot read arbitrary attached project files.
Accepted PDF/XLSX/source-file formats do not establish ready parsing or rich preview.
Browser observations are bounded text, not visual QA.
Advertised report/script limits exceed adapter argument and model-output ceilings.
Bounded context and recent evidence require retrieval/continuity for longer jobs.
Verified-result UI conflates artifact integrity with semantic acceptance.
Native-browser transfers and developer-created Gmail OAuth setup remain adoption constraints.
challenge_review.minimum_experiment: Three users per audience, one constrained job per audience, two separate sessions with changed inputs; source-grounded human acceptance and comparison to existing method. Directional study only.
